page.overview:
What is Jirachi?

This Jirachi is a /-type Pokémon that appears in its major role in the feature-length film .

Jirachi is a Mythical Pokémon who awakens once every thousand years for a period of seven days, coinciding with the appearance of the Millennium Comet. It requires a human friend in order to fully awaken from its hibernation.

Prior to the series, Jirachi was found by Butler and Diane deep beneath Forina, in which it was held within the form of a purplish crystal. Butler aimed to use its limitless power in order to create a Groudon through artificial means, which he failed to do for Team Magma.

Later, Jirachi telepathically reached out to Max during Butler's magic show. When Jirachi emerged from its crystal, Butler attempted to use its powers to absorb the Comet's energy. Before the process could be completed, Ash and his friends intervened and fled with Diane to Forina.
